================================================================================
Asm return-type output without clobbers
================================================================================

pub fn syscall0(number: u64) u64 {
    return asm volatile ("ecall"
        : [ret] "={x10}" (-> u64),
        : [number] "{x17}" (number),
    );
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (function_declaration
    (identifier)
    (parameters
      (parameter
        (identifier)
        (builtin_type)))
    (builtin_type)
    (block
      (expression_statement
        (return_expression
          (asm_expression
            (string
              (string_content))
            (asm_output
              (asm_output_item
                (identifier)
                (string
                  (string_content))
                (builtin_type))
              (asm_input
                (asm_input_item
                  (identifier)
                  (string
                    (string_content))
                  (identifier))))))))))

================================================================================
Asm underscore output name
================================================================================

pub fn read() usize {
    return asm volatile ("nop"
        : [_] "={r3}" (-> usize),
    );
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (function_declaration
    (identifier)
    (parameters)
    (builtin_type)
    (block
      (expression_statement
        (return_expression
          (asm_expression
            (string
              (string_content))
            (asm_output
              (asm_output_item
                (identifier)
                (string
                  (string_content))
                (builtin_type)))))))))

================================================================================
Asm multiline template with string clobber
================================================================================

pub fn xor() void {
    asm volatile (
        \\ xor %%ecx, %%ecx
        \\ ret
        ::: "memory");
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (function_declaration
    (identifier)
    (parameters)
    (builtin_type)
    (block
      (expression_statement
        (asm_expression
          (multiline_string)
          (asm_output
            (asm_input
              (asm_clobbers
                (string
                  (string_content))))))))))
